usage: search.py [-h]
                 [--domain {style,color,chart,landing,product,ux,typography,icons,gsap,react,web,google-fonts}]
                 [--stack {react,nextjs,vue,svelte,astro,swiftui,react-native,flutter,nuxtjs,nuxt-ui,html-tailwind,shadcn,jetpack-compose,threejs,angular,laravel,javafx,wpf,winui,avalonia,uno,uwp}]
                 [--max-results 1-20] [--json] [--full] [--design-system]
                 [--project-name PROJECT_NAME] [--format {ascii,markdown}]
                 [--persist] [--page PAGE] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR] [--force]
                 [--variance 1-10] [--motion 1-10] [--density 1-10]
                 query

UI Pro Max Search

positional arguments:
  query                 Search query

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --domain, -d {style,color,chart,landing,product,ux,typography,icons,gsap,react,web,google-fonts}
                        Search domain
  --stack, -s {react,nextjs,vue,svelte,astro,swiftui,react-native,flutter,nuxtjs,nuxt-ui,html-tailwind,shadcn,jetpack-compose,threejs,angular,laravel,javafx,wpf,winui,avalonia,uno,uwp}
                        Stack-specific search. Available: react, nextjs, vue,
                        svelte, astro, swiftui, react-native, flutter, nuxtjs,
                        nuxt-ui, html-tailwind, shadcn, jetpack-compose,
                        threejs, angular, laravel, javafx, wpf, winui,
                        avalonia, uno, uwp
  --max-results, -n 1-20
                        Max results (default: 3)
  --json                Output as JSON
  --full                Do not truncate long field values in text output
  --design-system, -ds  Generate complete design system recommendation
  --project-name, -p PROJECT_NAME
                        Project name for design system output
  --format, -f {ascii,markdown}
                        Output format for design system (ignored if --json)
  --persist             Save design system to design-system/<project-
                        slug>/MASTER.md (creates hierarchical structure)
  --page PAGE           Create page-specific override file in design-
                        system/<project-slug>/pages/
  --output-dir, -o OUTPUT_DIR
                        Output directory for persisted files (default: current
                        directory -- pass this explicitly, pointed at the
                        project root)
  --force               Overwrite an existing MASTER.md when persisting
                        (default: skip if it already exists)
  --variance 1-10       DESIGN_VARIANCE dial: 1=centered/minimal,
                        10=bold/asymmetric (only with --design-system)
  --motion 1-10         MOTION_INTENSITY dial: 1=subtle, 10=complex; pulls a
                        matching GSAP snippet from motion.csv (only with
                        --design-system)
  --density 1-10        VISUAL_DENSITY dial: 1=spacious, 10=dense/dashboard;
                        overrides the spacing scale (only with --design-
                        system)
